title: At the Threshing Floor
backstory: Boaz had told his workers to drop extra handfuls of grain on purpose so Ruth would find them (Ruth 2:16), and Naomi noticed. He was near of kin to them, she said, one of their own kinsmen (Ruth 2:20). In Israel a kinsman could buy back a poor relative's land (Leviticus 25:25) and keep a dead man's name alive in the family (Deuteronomy 25:6), and Naomi saw in that a way forward for them both.

passages.synopsis: Naomi wanted to find a secure home for Ruth. She told Ruth to go to Boaz at the threshing floor that night. Ruth was to ask him, as a near kinsman, to take her under his care. Ruth trusted Naomi and did all she said.

That night Ruth quietly asked Boaz to spread his covering over her, a request to redeem her. Boaz blessed her for her kindness and faithfulness. He promised to do all she asked, for the whole town knew she was a virtuous woman. But there was a nearer kinsman to ask first.

Before dawn Boaz sent Ruth home with a generous gift of grain. Naomi told her to wait, sure that Boaz would settle the matter that very day. He was a man who would not rest until it was done. Their future now rested in his faithful hands.

triviaQuestions.question: What did Boaz call Ruth?
triviaQuestions.explanation: Ruth 3:11 — "And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to thee all that thou requirest: for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a virtuous woman."

triviaQuestions.question: What was a near kinsman able to do for Ruth and Naomi?
triviaQuestions.explanation: Ruth 3:9 — "And he said, Who art thou? And she answered, I am Ruth thine handmaid: spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid; for thou art a near kinsman."

triviaQuestions.question: What did Naomi tell Ruth to do at the threshingfloor?
triviaQuestions.explanation: Ruth 3:4 — "And it shall be, when he lieth down, that thou shalt mark the place where he shall lie, and thou shalt go in, and uncover his feet, and lay thee down; and he will tell thee what thou shalt do."

triviaQuestions.question: What did Boaz send home with Ruth before daybreak?
triviaQuestions.explanation: Ruth 3:15 — "Also he said, Bring the vail that thou hast upon thee, and hold it. And when she held it, he measured six measures of barley, and laid it on her: and she went into the city."

scrambleVerses.text: I will do to thee all that thou requirest:
Sit still, my daughter, until thou know how the matter will fall:
Blessed be thou of the LORD, my daughter:

reflection: Boaz was a redeemer who covered Ruth's need. How does that picture help you understand Jesus as Redeemer?
